clips.title: The story
paras: Around Lake Lordamere’s southern Dawning Isles, Lake Creeper Moss grows on aquatic beasts. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks the organic compound as a vital reagent for engineering a lethal new plague.

Lake Creeper Moss grows on the hides of freshwater beasts in the waters by the southern Dawning Isles. Lordaeron’s blighted waters shape its unusual properties. Before Arugal’s curse claimed his mind, Apothecary Berard recorded the moss in his journal. He noted its resemblance to traces found on fossils of creatures killed by an ancient plague in the lake. Forsaken agents send recovered samples to the Apothecarium in the Undercity, where Master Apothecary Faranell uses them in his research.
